content.title: Current Ratio
content.formula: Current ratio = Current assets / Current liabilities

body.heading: Conditions
bullets: Use comparable balance-sheet figures.

content.example: question: CA 200,000 and CL 100,000.; solution: 200,000/100,000.; answer: 2:1
content.whenToUse: Use for liquidity analysis.
content.commonMistake: Including non-current assets.

content.title: Accounting Equation
content.summary: Every transaction preserves the equality between assets and claims.

body.heading: Conditions
bullets: Every transaction has equal debit and credit effects.

content.explanation: Every transaction preserves the equality between assets and claims.
content.example: question: If liabilities are 20,000 and capital is 30,000, find assets.; solution: A=20,000+30,000.; answer: 50,000
content.whenToUse: Use to analyse the effect of transactions.
content.commonMistake: Treating revenue as a direct asset without considering capital effect.
